chunks: Surely those who oppose God and His Prophet will be among the vilest.

key_terms.يُحَادُّونَ: to contend with or oppose vigorously

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the most lowly according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing both general opponents and specifically the Ahl al-Bayt's adversaries, highlighting the spiritual demotion of those who actively dispute divine authority. It underscores the concept of 'idtirar' (humiliation) not merely as a worldly state but as a consequence of rejecting the Prophet's divinely appointed guidance. This aligns with the broader Quranic theme where opposition to the Prophet is equated with opposition to God Himself.
